Bash(.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh "Define the specification for integrating the frontend \(published Docusaurus website\) with the local FastAPI backend to enable end-to-end RAG chatbot functionality.

TECH STACK \(fixed\):
- Frontend: Docusaurus \(static site\)
- Backend: FastAPI \(local\)
- Agent Layer: OpenAI Agents SDK
- Retrieval: Qdrant + Cohere embeddings
- Communication: HTTP \(JSON\)
- Configuration: .env

FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Establish a reliable local connection between frontend and backend
- Enable the frontend to send user queries to the backend API
- Support sending user-selected text as contextual input
- Receive and render chatbot responses from the backend
- Handle loading, error, and empty-response states
- Ensure chatbot is accessible only on the homepage bottom area

NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Low-latency local interaction
- Clear request/response logging
- Graceful handling of backend unavailability
- No exposure of secrets in frontend code
- Cross-origin safety for local development

CONSTRAINTS:
- No redesign of backend logic
- No new agent or retrieval logic
- No authentication or user accounts
- No production deployment concerns" --number 1 --short-name "docusaurus-fastapi-integration")
